description: stoa_value_to_result treats any Value with a top-level 'type' key as a method-level error. This works because today's route_method handlers never return a success Value with a top-level 'type' key. If a future handler legitimately returns {'type': 'text/plain', ...} (e.g. following some extension spec), stoa_value_to_result will silently treat it as an error. The invariant is not documented. Add a doc comment on stoa_value_to_result stating the precondition explicitly.
title: stoa_value_to_result implicit contract: top-level type key = error, undocumented
